tactics: induction l using List.mergeSort.induct le <;> rw [List.mergeSort] <;> first | simp | (apply List.sorted_merge htrans (fun a b h => by have := htotal a b; simp_all) <;> assumption) | (apply List.pairwise_merge htrans (fun a b h => by have := htotal a b; simp_all) <;> assumption)
induction l using List.mergeSort.induct le <;> simp_all [List.mergeSort]
induction l using List.mergeSort.induct le <;> rw [List.mergeSort] <;> first | simp | (apply List.sorted_merge <;> first | assumption | exact htrans | (intro a b h; have := htotal a b; simp_all))
have htot : ∀ a b : α, (!le a b) = true → le b a = true := fun a b h => by have := htotal a b; simp_all
